meta_description: RJK Decorating is a professional painter and decorator in Newcastle. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painter & Decorator — Newcastle & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior decoration done right, on time, and at a fair price. Free quotes within 24 hours.
services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From complete home redecoration to commercial exterior work, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Full interior redecorating including feature walls, woodwork, and ceilings. We move furniture, protect your floors, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior work on rendered walls, cladding, and doors. We prepare surfaces properly to ensure paint lasts years, not months.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Refurbishment
services.desc: Transform tired kitchens and bathrooms with expert painting of units, tiles, and walls. We prep surfaces to prevent peeling in humid environments.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office and retail refurbishment scheduled around your business hours. We work efficiently to minimise disruption and complete on deadline.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging and removal. We source quality materials and apply them to walls in perfect condition, no bubbles or misaligns.

services.title: Undercoat & Preparation
services.desc: Proper surface prep makes all the difference. We fill, sand, and prime to guarantee a professional finish that stands the test of time.

about_pullquote: I started RJK because I'd seen too many cowboys cut corners on preparation. Proper prep is everything.
about_para_1: RJK Decorating has been transforming homes and businesses across Newcastle for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that preparation and attention to detail separate lasting results from quick fixes, we've built a reputation for reliable, honest work at fair prices. Every job is treated with the same care whether it's a single bedroom or a complete commercial refit.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us time and again because we turn up on time, protect your home while we work, and never pressure you into unnecessary extras. We're not the cheapest, but we're consistent—and many of our jobs come from word-of-mouth referrals from neighbours and previous clients. That's what matters to us.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About RJK Decorating

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs redecorated—lounge, hall, kitchen. RJ was tidy, punctual, and didn't fuss around. Finished on time, didn't leave a mess. Really pleased with the finish. Would use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Wallpapered three rooms for us. The prep work was meticulous—he took his time getting the walls right. You can see it's been done properly; not a bubble in sight. Fair price too. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Did our exterior this summer—soffits, fascia, and all the woodwork. Took weather concerns seriously and used quality paint. Eight months on and it still looks fresh. Honest bloke, no pressure selling.
reviews.author: David M.
